data.description: The Leg Extension is a seated station in Ocean Grey for strengthening the front of the thighs. The user sits, hooks the feet behind a pad and straightens the legs, then lowers them under control. Older users like it for building leg strength for stairs. It fits well beside an air walker in a park or society gym. It belongs to our Fun Fitness range. Exact dimensions and warranty terms are shared with the layout drawing. Our sales team will confirm the Leg Extension's warranty; our standard terms are 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings and spare parts. Ask us to add it to your open gym layout.

items.pText: The Leg Extension is a seated station in Ocean Grey for strengthening the front of the thighs. The user sits, hooks the feet behind a pad and straightens the legs, then lowers them under control. Older users like it for building leg strength for stairs. It fits well beside an air walker in a park or society gym. It belongs to our Fun Fitness range. Exact dimensions and warranty terms are shared with the layout drawing. Our sales team will confirm the Leg Extension's warranty; our standard terms are 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings and spare parts. Ask us to add it to your open gym layout.

The leg arm pivots under the seat, so check that joint and the seat bolts at each service. The Leg Extension can be installed self-standing or grouted. Leave room in front of the seat for the leg arm's full swing, and keep the seat surface clean of dust and leaves.
